name: Barrow County, GA
findings: Barrow County has 182 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Barrow County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Barrow County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
